decision.reason: [ev-c4d7d1a131dd] is just a one-line title in the release notes: "convert unpinned Ubuntu EC2NodeClasses" with a link to PR #6699. It doesn't say which EC2NodeClass field or value counts as "unpinned Ubuntu", what the conversion turns it into (before/after), whether it happens automatically or is something the operator must do, or what happens to an exposed environment if nothing is done. The PR description or diff, or an upgrade-guide section covering Ubuntu EC2NodeClasses, would be needed to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
